chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Rifāʿah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about one who remained unconscious for a month: what of the salat (prayer) must he make up? He said: He makes up all of it, for the matter of salat (prayer) is severe.

key_terms.أَمْرَ ٱلصَّلَاةِ: the matter and obligation of salat (prayer)
key_terms.شَدِيدٌ: grave, weighty, or severe in importance
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he makes up or performs missed acts later
key_terms.يَقْضِيهَا كُلَّهَا: he must make up all of the missed prayers
key_terms.ٱلْمُغْمَىٰ عَلَيْهِ: a person who has lost consciousness

ai.seo_question: Does a person who was unconscious for a month have to make up all missed salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who was unconscious for a month. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that all missed salat (prayer) must be made up, emphasizing the gravity and seriousness of salat (prayer) in the religion.
